text:
fiona: quick repro on staging: streaming -> toolcall -> client truncate -> reconnect via different router => two confirmed ledger rows.

ben: paste trimmed trace pls.

fiona: trace: `STREAM_START id=sessX model=psi seq=0
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=20 prefix="Hi"
TOOLCALL start id=tc42
CLIENT_TRUNCATE reason=killed
LEDGER provisional tokens=20 session=sessX
RECONNECT via router=eu-1 session=sessX-1
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=20 prefix="Hi"
LEDGER confirmed tokens=20 session=sessX-1`

hao: likely router cache/ownership race. two fixes: (A) write an opaque continuity_token with provisional rows and propagate it on resume; confirm path tries attach-by-token first. (B) add 8b prefix_fingerprint on chunks for fuzzy fallback.

ben: DB: store continuity_token on provisional row with short TTL. confirm should do transactional SELECT FOR UPDATE provisional WHERE continuity_token=X; if found attach, else fallback to prefix match within 30s. CAS to avoid double-attach.

kyra: console/ops: add "provisional" column, drilldown to traces, and dashboard metrics: provisional.orphan.count, attach.rate, unmatched_confirm. Alert if unmatched_confirm > 5/min for 10m.

billing-bot: ticket BILL-3001 created "Provisional attach by continuity_token + console visibility" assigned: billing, eng-platform, console.

deploy-bot: feature-flag rollout scheduled: provisional-attach -> 1% canary -> 2024-09-12T14:00:00Z.

fiona: thanks. I'll own telemetry + PR for prefix_fingerprint. hao will handle DB txn. please drop customer escalations here.
